# MakeHuman assets (CC0 1.0)

Source: https://github.com/makehumancommunity/makehuman @ a8bc2d54ff0ac92e78ff71431b1023eda42bf482
License: CC0 1.0 Universal (`LICENSE.CC0.md`, the repository's LICENSE.ASSETS.md). Each target file states
"This asset was explicitly released as CC0 in september 2020"; the weights file declares "license": "CC0".

| File | Original path |
|---|---|
| base.obj | makehuman/data/3dobjs/base.obj |
| default_weights.mhw | makehuman/data/rigs/default_weights.mhw |
| targets/*-young.target | makehuman/data/targets/macrodetails/ |

`scripts/build_body_makehuman.py` turns these into `public/body.glb`.
